blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) said it is prepared to transfer former House Speaker Martin Romualdez to the New Quezon City Jail in Payatas, where his fellow lawmakers are committed also due to nonbailable plunder cases. High-profile detainees currently at the Payatas facility include Senator Jinggoy Estrada, who is facing a P573-million case involving alleged kickbacks from flood-control projects; and Senator Rodante Marcoleta and his co-accused, former congressman Mike Defensor, for failing to declare P75 million in campaign donations.
